question: A can complete a piece of work in 20 days and B can do it in 15 days. In how many days will they complete the work together?
A can do a piece of work in 10 days and B can do the same work in 20 days. With the help of C, they finish the work in 5 days. In how many days can C alone complete the work?
Anmol is three times as efficient as Vinay and therefore can finish a job 60 days earlier than Vinay. In how many days will they finish the job working together?

topic: Relative Efficiency from Combined Time Differences
question: Two women, Renu and Ushi, are working on an embroidery design. If Ushi worked alone, she would need eight hours more than the time required by both together. If Renu worked alone, she would need 4.5 hours more than the time required by both together. How much time would Renu alone take to complete the design?
A can do a work in 18 days, B in 9 days and C in 6 days. A and B start working together and C joins them after 2 days. In how many days will the work be completed?

Dev and Tukku can do a piece of work in 45 days and 40 days respectively. They begin working together, but Dev leaves after some days and Tukku finishes the remaining work in 23 days. After how many days did Dev leave?

Abbot, Bill and Clinton can complete a work in 10 days, 20 days and 40 days respectively. They work in turns with Abbot on day 1, Bill on day 2 and Clinton on day 3. In how many days will the work be completed?
Thirty men working 5 hours a day can complete a work in 16 days. In how many days can 20 men working 6 hours a day complete the same work?
Twenty-four men working 8 hours a day complete a work in 10 days. If they work 10 hours a day, how many men are required to finish the same work in 6 days?

A project is to be completed in 60 days and 90 men are set to work, each working 6 hours a day. After 20 days, only one-fifth of the work is finished. How many additional men need to be employed so that the work may be completed on time if each man now works 8 hours a day?
A group of men was assigned a job to be completed in 20 days. Twelve men did not turn up, and the work was completed in 32 days. What was the original number of men?
Baba can complete a work in 10 days and Anshu in 15 days. If the total wages for the work are ₹50 and they work together throughout, how much should Baba receive?

topic: Wage Sharing with a Third Worker
question: Ajay and Vijay undertake a job for ₹200. Ajay alone can do it in 24 days and Vijay alone in 30 days. With the help of Pradeep, they finish the work in 12 days. How much should Pradeep receive?
The rate at which tap X fills a tank is 50% more than that of tap Y. If both the taps are opened simultaneously, they take 40 hours to fill the tank. The time taken by Y alone to fill the tank is
Pipe A fills a tank in 10 hours and Pipe B empties it in 15 hours. How long will it take to fill a tank that is initially half full if both pipes are opened together?

topic: Leakage Rate from Extra Filling Time
question: Two pipes can fill a cistern in 12 hours and 18 hours respectively. They are opened simultaneously, but due to a leak in the bottom the cistern takes 48 minutes extra to get filled. When the cistern is full, in how many hours will the leak alone empty it?

A dam has four inlets. Through the first three inlets, the dam can be filled in 12 minutes; through the second, third and fourth inlet, it can be filled in 15 minutes; and through the first and fourth inlet, it can be filled in 20 minutes. In how many minutes will all the four inlets together fill the dam?

Two taps together can fill a tank in 4 hours. Individually they can fill it in 5 hours and 20 hours respectively. A leak delays the filling by one hour. In how many hours can the leak empty the full tank?
Pipes A and B together can fill a cistern in 6 minutes. If B takes 5 minutes more than A to fill the cistern alone, in what time can A and B fill it separately?

Three taps A, B and C can fill a tank in 10, 20 and 25 hours respectively. All are opened together. After 2 hours C is closed, and after 4 hours B is closed. What percentage of the work is done by A alone?

A, B and C can complete a work in 8, 10 and 20 hours respectively. At most one person can work during any hour and no one is allowed to work in two consecutive hours. What is the minimum number of hours required to complete the work?
The difference between the simple interest on a certain amount at 20% per annum for 1.5 years and compound interest at the same rate compounded every six months is ₹155. Find the principal amount.
In how many years will a sum of ₹18000 at 20% per annum compounded half-yearly become ₹23958?
A sum of money doubles itself in 5 years. In how many years will it become four times itself if interest is compounded?

An amount of ₹12820 due 3 years hence is fully repaid in three annual instalments starting after 1 year. The first instalment is half the second and the second is two-thirds of the third. If the interest rate is 10% per annum, find the first instalment.

Mohit Anand borrows a sum from a bank at 10% compound interest. The debt is discharged by two equal annual payments of ₹1000 each at the end of the first and second years. Approximately what amount was borrowed?

A sum is divided between A and B in the ratio 1 : 2. A purchases a car that depreciates at 14 2/7% per annum while B deposits his amount in a bank paying 20% per annum compounded annually. Approximately by what percentage will the total wealth increase after two years?

Kaalia borrowed money at 15% simple interest for 2 years. He then lent half of it to Mallya at 16% compounded half-yearly and the other half to Jaalia at 15% compounded annually, both for 2 years. Approximately what percentage profit on the original amount did Kaalia earn?

You borrow the same amount at 12% simple interest and at 10% simple interest for the same period. The first loan is repaid six months early while the second is repaid on schedule. In both cases the amount repaid is ₹92625. Determine the principal and the time period.

The population growth rate of a city follows an increasing AP with first-year rate 5% and common difference 5%, while migration follows an increasing GP with first term 1% and common ratio 2. If the population on 31 December 2010 is one million, in which year will the city witness its first fall in population?

A certain sum of money was lent under the following simple interest scheme: 8% per annum for the initial 2 years, 9.5% per annum for the next 4 years, 11% per annum for the next 2 years and 12% per annum thereafter. Find the amount to which a sum of ₹9000 taken for 12 years will grow.

A certain amount grows at an annual interest rate of 12%, compounded monthly. Which of the following equations can be used to find the number of years y required for the investment to increase by a factor of 64?

A man invests a total of ₹17 lakh. Part of it is invested at 6%, and the remainder is invested in two banks in the ratio 3:1 at 5% and 4% respectively. If the total annual interest earned is ₹92000, find the amount invested at 6%.

topic: Simple Interest with Different Starting Times
question: Abhijit invested ₹20000 at 6% simple interest, while Amartya invested ₹18000 at 10% simple interest five years later. After how many years from Abhijit's investment will Amartya's accumulated amount exceed Abhijit's accumulated amount?

Mr. Suratkal divides ₹20 lakh between his two sons aged 15 and 12 years so that both receive the same amount at age 21. If the investments earn 12% compounded annually, approximately how much should be invested for the younger son?
